claims.claim_text: Unified clause-aware natural-language stoppage deconvolution across 41,396 Phase II-IV trials (29,791 target-resolved) separates operational/commercial halts (51.4% of stoppages) from biological failures at kappa = 0.9413 and uncovers a 1.57-fold efficacy futility excess for ~150-kDa IgG monoclonal antibodies relative to small molecules.

evidence_lines.summary: 41,396 unique trials (29,791 target-resolved; 51.4% operational stops) validated on an independent 240-trial clinical adjudication benchmark (95.83% accuracy, kappa = 0.9413 vs 0.6105 naive keyword baseline).

150-kDa IgG monoclonal antibodies exhibit 1.57-fold higher explicit biological efficacy futility odds than small molecules (Fisher P = 2.26e-4 across 25,271 regimens) without excess systemic toxicity.

claims.sensitivity_or_boundary_note: Bounded across 7 registry sensitivity regimes (R1-R7), including worst-case assignment of all 2,618 target-resolved unreported stoppages to biological failure (R3 AUROC = 0.6533) and regulatory-approval gold standards (R6 AUROC = 0.6767).

claims.claim_text: Static healthy single-cell target specificity performs near chance on deconfounded scientific trial outcomes (AUROC = 0.5387), whereas Dynamic Niche Accessibility (DNAcc) integrating diseased-niche specificity, progression drift, and ECM steric compatibility achieves AUROC = 0.6710 and transfers zero-shot across unseen organ axes (Core-6 LODO AUROC = 0.6306).

evidence_lines.summary: Six-step nested ablation across 11,637 scientific trials elevates AUROC from 0.5387 (M1 healthy tau_0) to 0.6614 (M3 early disease) and 0.6710 (M6 full DNAcc, paired DeLong P = 1.11e-21).

Holding out entire organ disease axes under intercept-free regularized Leave-One-Disease-Axis-Out transfer (n = 5,662 Core-6 trials) achieves pooled OOF AUROC = 0.6306 (+0.1431 over healthy tau_0, P = 5.19e-16).

claims.sensitivity_or_boundary_note: Intravascular bloodstream sepsis (GSE167363 PBMCs, D_ECM = 0.0700) provides the expected negative physical boundary where interstitial ECM steric gating does not apply (maturation AUROC = 0.3822).

claims.claim_text: Dynamic Niche Accessibility is statistically orthogonal to Open Targets human genetic target support and combines additively with human genetics to reach AUROC = 0.7023 on scientific trial outcomes (0.7210 on Phase II-to-III/IV maturation), remaining independently predictive after five-family target-clustered multivariable adjustment.

evidence_lines.summary: Joint Human Genetics + DNAcc improves discrimination from 0.6362 (Open Targets genetics alone) to 0.7023 (+0.0661, two-sided paired DeLong P = 1.58e-10; unseen-target Group5Fold 0.6844 vs 0.6175).

DNAcc retains full predictive power strictly within genetically supported targets (AUROC = 0.6916, P = 3.59e-25), under Liang-Zeger 374-target sandwich regression (adjusted OR = 1.42, P_cluster = 2.81e-5), and across held-out organ axes (0.6306).

claims.sensitivity_or_boundary_note: Evaluated under target-gene-disjoint Group5Fold cross-validation across G = 374 scientific and G = 561 maturation target clusters to prevent target-level information leakage.

claims.claim_text: A closure-free three-compartment stochastic Ito-Langevin Waddington solver compiled exclusively from primary human biopsy donors with zero clinical trial outcome fitting predicts 24 Phase IIb/III antifibrotic trials across liver, lung, and kidney (AUROC = 0.8714), remaining invariant to ChEMBL v33 biochemical target potency while improving probability calibration under LOOO Platt recalibration (Brier = 0.1735).

evidence_lines.summary: Liver-compiled closure-free Langevin dynamics (all 4 directed edges structurally identifiable at Delta_chi2 > 3.841) predicts 24 SHA-256-locked Phase IIb/III trials across liver, lung, and kidney at AUROC = 0.8714 (exact permutation P = 0.0010; Core-14 AUROC = 0.9583).

Incorporating ChEMBL v33 human pXC50 (3.52-10.00) confirms sub-nanomolar affinity cannot rescue scar-excluded mAbs or drift-eroded targets (alpha=0.15 AUROC = 0.8643, P = 0.0021), while LOOO Platt recalibration lowers Brier error from 0.2072 to 0.1735.

Direct pharmacological perturbation across n = 73 human fibroblast/TGFBR1i RNA-seq profiles reverses the locked myofibroblast/ECM barrier without refitting (GSE226249 pirfenidone Delta = -0.48, P = 4.47e-6; GSE154646 RepSox P = 1.10e-3; GSE210020 nintedanib P = 0.0182), while macro DNAcc aligns with zero-label meso Langevin remission across all 24 trials (Spearman rho = 0.7861, P = 5.29e-6).

claims.sensitivity_or_boundary_note: Pulmonary and renal winners acting via hemodynamic or cAMP pathways compress raw basin probabilities (0.0535-0.2330 at 0.50 cutoff), resolved via LOOO Platt recalibration (76.4%-81.4% balanced accuracy); ziritaxestat reflects off-niche systemic toxicity.

claims.claim_text: Across 20,880 quality-filtered 10x Visium spots from 12 primary human carcinoma sections, concentric myCAF-TAM barriers exclude CD8+ effector T cells beyond library-depth, lineage-admixture, and 2D spatial-autocorrelation confounding (toroidal Stouffer Z = +7.82), enabling zero-label stratification across 107 strictly pre-treatment anti-PD-1 biopsies (AUROC = 0.6367; scRNA TME = 0.8750).

evidence_lines.summary: All 12 carcinoma Visium sections (20,880 QC spots) show positive peritumoral exclusion (Wilcoxon P = 2.44e-4), retaining 48.3% mean SEI after UMI/admixture residualization with 24,000 toroidal cyclic shifts yielding Stouffer Z = +7.82 (P = 2.69e-15).

Zero-label Visium-informed Langevin solver achieves AUROC = 0.6367 (exact P = 0.0187) across 107 strictly pre-treatment anti-PD-1 biopsies (0.8750 in intact single-cell TME cohorts GSE123813 BCC and GSE207422 NSCLC), outperforming static PD-L1 (0.5610) and 18-gene GEP (0.5948).

claims.sensitivity_or_boundary_note: Bulk RNA-seq tissue homogenization collapses spatial shell geometry toward linear-combination parity (0.6367 vs 0.6442 Linear Mean on bulk-dominated n = 107), whereas single-cell TME preserves spatial-Langevin advantage (0.8750 vs 0.7500/0.8250).

claims.claim_text: High pre-treatment transcriptomic stromal barrier load predicts significantly worse overall survival across 74 anti-PD-1 monotherapy melanoma patients both univariably (HR = 1.95, log-rank P = 0.0279) and after multivariable Breslow Cox adjustment for clinical cohort, tumor burden, static PD-L1, and 18-gene GEP (HR = 3.02, P = 0.0082, VanderWeele E-value = 3.68).

evidence_lines.summary: Above-median pre-treatment stromal CAF-exclusion barrier predicts mortality across n = 74 melanoma monotherapy patients (43 deaths; HR = 1.95, log-rank P = 0.0279; cohort-stratified HR = 1.91, P = 0.0340; median OS 18.8 vs 34.2 months).

Simultaneously adjusting for cohort, tumor burden, static PD-L1, and 18-gene GEP strengthens locked stromal barrier hazard to HR = 3.02 (95% CI 1.33-6.84, P = 0.0082, E-value = 3.68, lower CI E-value = 1.74), while continuous linear CAF is null (HR = 1.08, P = 0.651).

Across n = 264 non-ICB metastatic melanoma patients (149 deaths; GSE65904 + GSE22153), multivariable stromal barrier hazard is null (HR = 0.84, 95% CI 0.56-1.25, P = 0.389), establishing a significant anti-PD-1 x locked stromal barrier interaction across n = 338 melanoma patients (192 deaths; interaction HR = 3.60, 95% CI 1.45-8.98, P = 0.0059).

claims.sensitivity_or_boundary_note: Two-regime comparison across 338 melanoma patients (74 anti-PD-1 vs 264 non-ICB) demonstrates immunotherapy-specific survival hazard (interaction HR = 3.60, P = 0.0059), while prospective randomized anti-PD-1 +/- TGFBR1 blockade trials remain warranted for interventional confirmation.
